repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate adds an extra `if` block (lines 5-7) that folds negative differences to positive values using `abs()`. The IR contains no such logic; it strictly evaluates `$t2 - $t1 >= 3`. This causes actions when the temperature dropped (e.g., 3 -> 0, diff -3, folded to 3), whereas the IR would take no action. Evidence F2 confirms an extra action was emitted at 1200000 ms.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value folding logic (`diff = t1 - t2` when `diff < 0`). The revised script strictly computes `t2 - t1` and checks if it is `>= 3`, matching the IR's conditional behavior exactly.
